<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var list = document.querySelector('.news-list');
  if (!list) return;
  var isHome = document.getElementById('lab-updates') !== null;
  var items = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('.update-item'));

  function newsDate(item) {
    var dateSpan = item.querySelector('span[style*="monospace"]');
    return dateSpan ? Number(dateSpan.textContent.trim().replace(/\D/g, '')) : 0;
  }

  items.sort(function (a, b) { return newsDate(b) - newsDate(a); });
  items.forEach(function (item, index) {
    list.appendChild(item);
    item.style.display = isHome && index >= 2 ? 'none' : '';
  });

  var emptyMessage = document.getElementById('no-recent-news');
  if (emptyMessage) emptyMessage.hidden = items.length > 0;
});
</script>
